7 prinsip audit yang dipegang di setiap: 7 audit principles upheld in every assignment
Tahapan audit berdasarkan pendekatan kla: Audit stages based on clauses 5 and 6 of ISO 19011:2026
Tujuan program audit ditetapkan selaras: Audit programme objectives are set in line with the organisation's strategic direction, policies, and management system goals, guiding all audit planning and execution.
Penentuan & evaluasi risiko dan peluang: Determining & evaluating audit programme risks and opportunities
Risiko dan peluang yang dapat memengaruh: Risks and opportunities affecting the audit programme are identified and evaluated, such as planning, resources, team competence, communication, and information security, following the latest risk-based approach.
Peran dan tanggung jawab pengelola progr: Programme manager roles and responsibilities are set; auditor competence, programme extent/scope, schedule, and resources are determined, including onsite, remote, or combined audit methods.
Tujuan, lingkup, dan kriteria tiap audit: Objectives, scope, and criteria of each audit are defined; audit methods selected; audit team members assigned by competence; and programme results properly documented and managed.
Pelaksanaan program dipantau: kesesuaian: Programme execution is monitored: schedule adherence, objective achievement, audit team performance, and auditee feedback are evaluated as the basis for programme adjustments when needed.
Program audit ditinjau secara berkala un: The audit programme is reviewed periodically to assess achievement of its objectives; lessons learned feed continual improvement of the next period's programme.
Kontak awal dengan auditee dibangun; rua: Initial contact with the auditee is established; scope, criteria, and audit feasibility are confirmed, including agreed access to documents, work areas, and personnel to be audited.
Tinjauan informasi terdokumentasi, penyu: Review of documented information, risk-based audit planning, team work assignments, and preparation of working documents such as checklists and findings forms, tailored to the auditee's business processes.
Opening meeting; pengumpulan dan verifik: Opening meeting; evidence collection and verification through interviews, field observation, and document review; formulation of findings (Major, Minor, OFI) and audit conclusions; closed with a closing meeting.
Laporan audit yang komprehensif, akurat,: A comprehensive, accurate, concise, and clear audit report, containing findings, supporting evidence, and opportunities for improvement, is distributed to the relevant parties as agreed in the audit programme.
Audit dinyatakan selesai setelah seluruh: The audit is complete once all planned activities are done and the report distributed; documented information is retained or disposed of per agreement and confidentiality.
Efektivitas tindakan koreksi dan perbaik: The effectiveness of corrections and corrective actions on findings is verified at follow-up, ensuring improvements truly run in the field, not just on paper.
